en: Fixed a case where certificate errors behind a TLS-inspecting proxy persisted when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` was set. With it set, Claude Code now makes a TLS handshake with the configured API host after a certificate failure, through your http\:// proxy if one is set; it sends no API request
zh: 修复了在设置 `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` 时，TLS 检查代理背后的证书错误仍然存在的问题。设置该变量后，证书失败时 Claude Code 现在会与配置的 API 主机进行 TLS 握手，若设置了 http\:// 代理则通过该代理进行；不会发送任何 API 请求
